name: _cast_Int
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI): aten::_cast_Int(Tensor self, bool non_blocking=False) -> Tensor. All supplied registered schema strings, verbatim: aten::_cast_Int(Tensor self, bool non_blocking=False) -> Tensor. This representative overload is not exclusive: the original Gems pytest owns the full contract for overloads, keyword arguments, returns, errors, aliasing and mutation, and its coverage must never be narrowed to this one signature. Semantics: the operator returns an int32 tensor and every expectation is compared against the same-device native reference, so truncation toward zero and int64/out-of-int32 narrowing are decided by that reference. The pytest asserts the candidate reproduces the reference's input/output identity relation, not one unconditional behavior: for int32 inputs it checks (res_out is inp) == (ref_out is ref_inp) over contiguous, transposed, offset-row, scalar and empty views, and for empty inputs it mirrors the reference's same-object relation. For other input dtypes (bool, float8/float16/bfloat16/float32/float64, the narrower integer types, and complex64) the result must live on the input's device and be numerically equal to the reference. Strided and non-contiguous views must reproduce the reference strides exactly. Sparse COO inputs are covered only when the runtime's static int64 support flag is set, and the candidate's coalesced flag, shape and raw stored entries (nnz and duplicates included) must match the reference, so no workload densifies, coalesces or deduplicates the input. non_blocking is a bool flag with default false, accepted both positionally and by keyword; an invalid non_blocking, a non-Tensor self, or a missing self raises TypeError/RuntimeError. Effects here are schema-level only (no mutates, no argument aliases); any shared-object identity between input and result is overload-dependent, conditional behavior compared against the reference and deliberately not modeled as a mutation or aliasing effect. No non-JSON ATen defaults need string rendering for this signature: the only default, non_blocking=False, is a JSON boolean copied as supplied.
